description: Hermes Agent through the vendor's PowerShell installer, installed and never launched, found by the hermes-acp.exe launcher it writes under %LOCALAPPDATA%.
why: The idle twin of 107. Nothing is launched, so the launcher on disk is the only witness: filesystem-windows.sql's per-user launcher branch reads %LOCALAPPDATA%\<app>\bin\, and require_rows holds the file row to hermes-acp.exe, the catalogued value. setup prints the hermes process rows, which must be none. 107 requires the same file row beside a running process; this scenario proves the file route with no process to lean on.
known_gaps: Only a launcher one level under %LOCALAPPDATA% is read: an installer that keeps its commands deeper, or outside bin\, is still invisible while idle.
